message: Shiori-san isn't here.
(Answer the phone)

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yooo~ it's me. Where are you right now? You nearby?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I'm at the convenience store~. Y'know, the usual spot~. Can you come over real quick?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I've got something from Shiorin, a letter. She said it's for you~"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So, are you nearby? You comin'?"
"I'll go right away."
"I'm at the park."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Roger~. See ya soon."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Which park are we talking about? Anyway, you can come right away, yeah?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I'll be waiting, 'kay~? See ya soon."
Time to go.
(Convenience store)

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hm? Yooo."
"Hello."
"Yooo."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hey hey, hello~"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Whoa, changed your vibe or something? Yo yo~"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Here ya go, a letter from Shiorin~!"
"Thank you."
Let's see what it says.
<To you, who's always so kind to me:>
<Thanks to you, I was able to gradually recover my memories. But after what happened yesterday, even I don't get myself anymore.>
<If what he said was true, if I really were a murderer, if I really did kill my own sister...>
<I can't say for sure that I wouldn't harm you if my memories were to return.>
<So from here on, I'll try to manage on my own.>

<I'm sorry it had to end like this. 
Thank you for everything, truly. 
Goodbye.>
<-Kugayama Shiori>

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I'm guessing... that letter wasn't the happy sort."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Shiorin was acting pretty weird, y'know~. She was pretty down. Like, really down."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Something happen? You two had a fight or something?"
(Tell her what happened)

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ooooh... So that's what happened."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So Shiorin killed that old dude, huh? That's... kinda shocking. If it's actually true, I mean."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So? She's like, 'I might be a serial killer, so let's stop hanging out?' Is that it?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Oh, crap. The guilt just hit me hard. Maybe I shouldn't have told her about that old dude."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "No, but, uh... At least she learned something about herself, I guess? Wait, maybe she was better off not knowing? That she might've been a serial killer and all."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hah? What's with that face?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ah... Okay, okay. We're still not sure yet. Yeah, I know."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "But like, hear me out, alright? Let me make things clear."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Even I can't believe it, y'know? Shiorin's super nice, and she's a good person."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "But you still gotta be prepared for the worst, yeah? Shiorin went off on her own because she had a bad feeling too, didn't she?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "She wanted to know who she really was, yeah? Then it turns out the, uh... right, the truth. Then it turns out the truth was pretty messed up."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "You can't just say, 'nah, that can't be it,' just because you didn't like it. That'd be rude to Shiorin, yeah?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "You're her friend, right? Doesn't that mean you've gotta accept her, no matter what she's like?"
Time to go.

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Whoa, hey, hey, hey! Where you going?"
"To prove Shiori-san's innocence."
"To find out the truth."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Innocence... innocence, eh?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "The truth... Hmm, the truth, eh?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Well, I reaaaally get where you're coming from, but..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Can you even do that on your own? Like, do you even know what to do?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "What, you don't even have a plan? You suuure you're gonna be okay? You're being kinda unreliable right now."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "How about I tag along? Not like I have anything better to do, anyway."
(Accept)
(Decline)

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ah, got it. You're being stubborn. Well, maybe I shouldn't have said it that way."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Come back if you change your mind, yeah? I'll hang around for a bit longer. You can call, too."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Anyway, don't do anything reckless, 'kay~?"
"Thanks for everything."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "You're welcome~. Good luck out there~"
Time to go.
(Library)
(Library)

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Apologies, I was absorbed in my reading."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...? You're alone today."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Ah, you needn't answer that. Please, have a seat."
(Take a seat)

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Since Kugayama-san isn't here, we'll have to communicate in writing—Ah, right. You have your smartphone."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I can't say I care much for people fiddling with their phones right in front of me, but I suppose there's no avoiding it for now."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "So, what brings you here today?"
(Tell her what happened)

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Yesterday, you met a man who was likely the culprit behind the Preschool Girl Serial Kidnapping and Murder Case. Then, he claimed that Kugayama-san killed him—"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "—along with her own sister."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "However, all of this is based solely on the man's testimony. There is no evidence, and Kugayama-san has not even recovered her memories yet."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Even so, Kugayama-san could not completely rule out the possibility that she is a murderer. Therefore, she chose to act separately so that she would not, even by chance, end up harming you."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Is my understanding correct?"
(Nod)

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "You seem quite troubled."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Kugayama-san has not come here."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "If she is still pursuing the case, she may stop by eventually. However..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "If she said her goodbyes to you, then she may not turn to me either."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Your goal is to find Kugayama-san, and to prove her innocence. Is that correct?"
(Nod)

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I see. I'd go with you if I could, but as I mentioned before, I cannot leave this place."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "That's why, I'd like you to keep these two points in mind as you proceed."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "First. Ghosts can have very vague memories."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "The testimony of the man thought to be the culprit is not necessarily the truth. It is entirely possible that he is confusing it with another memory and simply believes it to be so."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Second. Ghosts can lie."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Malevolent ghosts will, naturally, lie with malicious intent."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "In other words, even if a ghost's memories are intact, what they say is not necessarily the truth."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It is no different from the living."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "In any case..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "His claim that she is a murderer is something I find highly doubtful as well."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "While this is only my impression, and no more reliable than anyone else's, Kugayama-san appeared to be a genuinely good person."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "This has to be some sort of misunderstanding. I'm sure the day will come when you and Kugayama-san can laugh together once more."
(Express your thanks)

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "At present, I have no new information to share. All I can offer are words of comfort, which makes me all the more sorry."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I will continue the investigation. There may still be something important we have overlooked."
(Express your thanks again)

name: Ms. Librarian
message:
"No need to thank me. 
...We're friends, after all."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Still... it would be worrying to let you go alone. If only there was someone else you could rely on..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ain't that me~?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Found ya~!"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Long time no see. It's rare for you to come to the library."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yeah, I kinda felt like reading a book or something, but nah, it didn't work. I like moving my body more."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Wait—'found you'? Do you have business with Shiori-san's buddy?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yep yep. I was getting worried, so I went looking."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Let's look for Shiorin together, yeah? It'd be rough going at it alone."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ah, you don't need to say anything. This lady totally loses it if you do."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Anyways, it's final. I'm not letting you say no~"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...That was rather forceful."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yeah, 'cause our pal here's always holding back."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Well, her network does make her a reliable ally. Going with her may be the wiser choice."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Whaddya mean, 'may'? It's a sure thing."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "C'mon, get up. Let's go already~!"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Anyway, we're off~. We'll come back and let you know if we find Shiorin~"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Yes, I'll be waiting."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Alright, let's go~!"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Y'know... I'm kinda worried Shiorin's gonna end up like how she was before."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So stop holding back, alright? We're in this together~"
"How she was?"
"Like before?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hm? You didn't know? When I first met Shiorin, things were really bad."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I'd try to talk to her and she'd barely react at all. Kinda like, she was about to go poof any second."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "But after she met you, she suddenly started talking like normal, so yeah, that kinda freaked me out."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Maybe she's the type who gets worse when she's alone. So if you let her be, she might start fading again, yeah?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "And if that happens... ah, well, never mind."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So, like, I know we're already going but the question is where, exactly?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Anyway, all we've gotta do is prove Shiorin's innocent, right? Uh... what was it called again?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "The Serial... something incident? That old dude was pretty much just framing her, yeah?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Which means, if we figure out who was behind that whatchamacallit incident, everything'll work itself out. Man, I'm a genius."

name: Gyaruko-san

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yeah, it's gotta be that old lady."

message: "Y'know, that hag who's basically running a gossip factory at the supermarket? ...Ah, was that a bit too rude?"

name: Gyaruko-san

name: Gyaruko-san

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Alright, no time like the present. C'mon, let's gooo!"

name: Tetsuya
message: "Excuse me, do you have a moment?"

name: Tetsuya
message: "I'm glad I caught up with you. I'm sorry about yesterday, for leaving so suddenly."

name: Tetsuya
message: "It's about Tomoko-san... There's something I want you to hear. Could you spare me a bit of your time?"
"Yes."
"No."

name: Tetsuya
message: "...I see. I suppose you've got a lot on your plate."

name: Tetsuya
message: "Then can you at least do me a favor?"

name: Tetsuya
message: "I wrote a letter. I want you to give it to Tomoko-san."

name: Tetsuya
message: "Please... I'm counting on you. Bye."
Tetsuya-san left.
A letter...
I should give it to Ms. Librarian.

name: Tetsuya
message: "Thank you. Shall we sit down and talk?"

name: Tetsuya
message: "I must've startled you when we first met. I'm sorry. I used to be better at talking to people."

name: Tetsuya
message: "Striking up conversations and listening to others was my job, after all."

name: Tetsuya
message: "I'd like to explain our circumstances... both Tomoko-san's and mine."

name: Tetsuya
message: "It's been... I wonder how long now. It was before this library was rebuilt, so it was quite a while ago."

name: Tetsuya
message: "Back then, I was a green, idealistic journalist, chasing down a certain case."

name: Tetsuya
message: "It was nothing unusual, a corruption scandal involving the local government."

name: Tetsuya
message: "But to me back then, it was a huge scoop—one I was willing to stake my career on."

name: Tetsuya
message: "That was also why I came to this library, to do some research."

name: Tetsuya
message: "There used to be a lot more people back then. The seats were always full."

name: Tetsuya
message: "Except this one corner. A young woman would always be sitting there by herself."

name: Tetsuya
message: "Nobody ever tried to sit near her. I didn't think much of it and took one of the empty seats."

name: Tetsuya
message: "And that's how I met Tomoko-san."

name: Tetsuya
message: "We never exchanged words. We were in a library, after all."

name: Tetsuya
message: "She always sat in the same spot, and for some reason, I always ended up in an empty seat nearby."

name: Tetsuya
message: "We'd sit at the same table. She'd read her books, and I'd do my research. That was it."

name: Tetsuya
message: "It was only after some time that I realized she wasn't ordinary."

name: Tetsuya
message: "I had a colleague who would sometimes come with me to the library."

name: Tetsuya
message: "He said that seat gave people the chills, which was why no one ever went near it. I was the only exception."

name: Tetsuya
message: "When I told him a woman sat there, his face immediately went pale. He said I might be haunted. It clearly unsettled him."

name: Tetsuya
message: "That's right. I was the only one who could see her."

name: Tetsuya
message: "She was a ghost."

name: Tetsuya
message: "And so the rumor spread about a ghost being there, and even fewer people went near."

name: Tetsuya
message: "Yet still, I kept sitting at my usual seat."

name: Tetsuya
message: "I became curious. Why was I the only one who could see her? Why was she always there?"

name: Tetsuya
message: "I wanted to know more about her. So I passed her a note."

name: Tetsuya
message: "I wrote my name on it, along with the question: 'What's your name?'"

name: Tetsuya
message: "She was a little surprised, but she wrote back. Beneath my clumsy handwriting, in neat letters... 'Tomoko.'"

name: Tetsuya
message: "After that, we started talking often. By writing, of course."

name: Tetsuya
message: "I naturally began telling her about my work."

name: Tetsuya
message: "At the time, I was trying to expose the malicious actions of an active councilman, how he pretended to stand for the voters while fraudulently collecting his secretary's salary."

name: Tetsuya
message: "I think Tomoko-san understood the social significance of my article—"

name: Tetsuya
message: "—and started doing research for me while I wasn't at the library."

name: Tetsuya
message: "I was shocked. I never imagined the day would come when I'd be getting help from a ghost librarian."

name: Tetsuya
message: "She was genuinely patient in helping me out with my work."

name: Tetsuya
message: "That said, she was very strict about library manners, especially about talking out loud."

name: Tetsuya
message: "But she was incredibly capable."

name: Tetsuya
message: "On the day we finished the article, I told her about my dream for the first time."

name: Tetsuya
message: "'Right now, all I write are dry, factual articles, but someday...'"

name: Tetsuya
message: "'Once I've fulfilled my duty as a journalist, I want to write novels that entertain and let people dream.'"

name: Tetsuya
message: "I told her I wanted to ease the burdens of troubled people, even if only a little."

name: Tetsuya
message: "I'd even started thinking about the story a bit."

name: Tetsuya
message: "A fairy tale set in a library at a small town, where a wise librarian helps resolve the townspeople's troubles."

name: Tetsuya
message: "It's a bit on the nose, I know. Maybe I just didn't have the talent to be a novelist."

name: Tetsuya
message: "But even so, Tomoko-san said she wanted to read it."

name: Tetsuya
message: "With the freshly finished article in hand, I told her, 'See you tomorrow.'"

name: Tetsuya
message: "It was the deadline—the day I submitted it."

name: Tetsuya
message: "But you see..."

name: Tetsuya
message: "Our article never saw the light of day."

name: Tetsuya
message: "It was shot down. In publishing, that isn't especially rare."

name: Tetsuya
message: "No matter how much a rookie reporter protests, it doesn't change a thing."

name: Tetsuya
message: "Looking back, there were other ways to get that article out."

name: Tetsuya
message: "But at the time, I didn't know how."

name: Tetsuya
message: "On the day our article was shot down, I couldn't bring myself to face Tomoko-san again, so I stopped coming."

name: Tetsuya
message: "And so I quit journalism. I lost the will to read, couldn't write anything, and spent my days in empty idleness."

name: Tetsuya
message: "One day, I found out the library was going to get renovated."

name: Tetsuya
message: "And once it was rebuilt, I might never be able to see Tomoko-san again."

name: Tetsuya
message: "I steeled my resolve, and finally went to see her again."

name: Tetsuya
message: "But when I arrived, Tomoko-san was no longer there."

name: Tetsuya
message: "I thought she had grown tired of me. The sense of loss I felt then is still vivid even now."

name: Tetsuya
message: "Pathetic as I was, I kept coming back for a few days, but Tomoko-san was nowhere to be found."

name: Tetsuya
message: "And then... I just stopped going."

name: Tetsuya
message: "I no longer had the energy to write novels, or even to make the trip."

name: Tetsuya
message: "And so, I decided to leave town."

name: Tetsuya
message: "But before that, I thought I should at least come one last time. And so I came back to this rebuilt library, driven by regret."

name: Tetsuya
message: "And as expected, she was nowhere to be found."

name: Tetsuya
message: "But then..."

name: Tetsuya
message: "That seat was empty..."

name: Tetsuya
message: "The building was new and crowded, yet that one seat stayed empty."

name: Tetsuya
message: "That was when I finally realized..."

name: Tetsuya
message: "She didn't disappear."

name: Tetsuya
message: "I simply stopped being able to see her."

name: Tetsuya
message: "Tomoko-san had been there... all this time."

name: Tetsuya
message: "Once I started wondering what kind of look she might be giving me, I got scared."

name: Tetsuya
message: "And so I ran."

name: Tetsuya
message: "I didn't want to accept the fact that I had disappointed Tomoko-san."

name: Tetsuya
message: "After that, I moved to another town, changed jobs, and then..."

name: Tetsuya
message: "...decades had passed. Even my memory of her had begun to fade."

name: Tetsuya
message: "I only came back to this town recently. I got curious, and found myself coming here, to this library."

name: Tetsuya
message: "That seat was still empty, just like before. But unlike then, there were fewer people now."

name: Tetsuya
message: "I couldn't tell whether Tomoko-san was there, or if it was simply empty by chance."

name: Tetsuya
message: "But then... you appeared."

name: Tetsuya
message: "You sat at that table, gazing at the empty seat and nodding, as though you were talking to someone."

name: Tetsuya
message: "I couldn't believe it... but I couldn't just sit still, so I called out to you."

name: Tetsuya
message: "Sorry about that. I wasn't exactly thinking straight."

name: Tetsuya
message: "And about yesterday, too."

name: Tetsuya
message: "Too much time had passed for me to put my thoughts into words right then."

name: Tetsuya
message: "And that's my story. Thank you for indulging an old man's ramblings."

name: Tetsuya
message: "I'm sorry, but can I ask you one last favor?"

name: Tetsuya
message: "I wrote my answer in this letter."

name: Tetsuya
message: "I want you to give it to Tomoko-san."

name: Tetsuya
message: "Please."
(Take the letter)
(Refuse)

name: Tetsuya
message: "Thank you."

name: Tetsuya
message: "I feel like a weight has finally been lifted."

name: Tetsuya
message: "Someone who can no longer see her... can't stay by her side anymore."

name: Tetsuya
message: "I think I can finally move on now."

name: Tetsuya
message: "Well then, goodbye."
Tetsuya-san left.

message: "Ah, hello. This is unusual. Are you here on your own today?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Please take a seat."

message: "It'll be difficult to communicate without Kugayama-san here. We'll have to write down—Ah, right. You have your smartphone."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I can't say I care much for people fiddling with their phones right in front of me, but I suppose there's no avoiding it today. Please type out your message and show it to me."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Will that be acceptable for you?"

message: "...? A letter? For... me?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "From..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Tetsuya...san?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "A letter... for me... from Tetsuya-san..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...A letter?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "He kept me waiting all these years... and all he has for me is a letter...?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I see... so he ran away again."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Apologies. I'm fine now."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I will read this letter... later. It is likely not what I'm hoping for."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It's a shame... It truly is."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Now then, I take it that is all—"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...I suppose not. You look rather troubled."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I assume it's related to Kugayama-san's absence?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Could you please tell me more, then? About why you came here alone."

name: Tetsuya

name: Tetsuya
message: "I know I'm asking for a lot. I really do. But please... You're the only one I know who can see Tomoko-san."

name: Tetsuya
message: "You're the only one I can count on."

name: Tetsuya
message: "I'm sorry for taking up your time, but... please, please..."

name: Tetsuya
message: "Thank you... I really appreciate it."

name: Tetsuya

name: Tetsuya

message: "But... the seat's empty as always... She's there, isn't she? On that seat?"

name: Tetsuya
message: "I mean... Look, I really do feel bad dragging you into this. I really do."

name: Tetsuya
message: "But could you please stop teasing me? She's there, right? On that seat."

name: Tetsuya
message: "So she really is there..."

name: Tetsuya

name: Tetsuya
message: "I see... So she really is there, on that seat..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Those features..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Tetsuya...san...?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...So you won't look me in the eye, just like back then."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...No, rather... you can't see me..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "You are alive, and I am dead. It is only natural."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Please tell him to sit down. Just this once, I will tolerate you speaking out loud."

name: Tetsuya

name: Tetsuya
message: "A pen and paper...? Ah, yes, I do. I'll take them out."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It's strange. Sitting in front of you like this brings me back to how I felt back then."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "The time I spent with you was a happy one."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "There is so much we have to talk about."
<The article was never published. I've wanted to apologize for a long time.>
<That was your article. You have no reason to apologize.>
<To me, it was our article.>
<I feel terrible, especially after everything you've done for me.>
<I was just doing my job as a librarian.>
<Besides, I enjoyed it.>
<Thank you.>
<Did you ever write your novel?>
<No, not yet.>
<We need to stop letting the past bind us. It ends today.>
<For both our sakes.>
<Are you going to disappear, Tomoko-san?>
<No, I won't.>
<Not until I've finished reading every book in this world.>
<Until I read the novel you'll write someday, the one that gives people hope—>
<—I won't disappear.>
<When I finish it, I'll bring it here.>
<I promise. This time, for sure.>
<I'll be waiting.>

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Please wait."

message: "I am now free from the regrets that bound me to that place."

message: "Along with my fear of not being there when he comes to see me."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Were you lying in wait for that man, planning to hear his story on your own?"

name: Shiori

name: Ms. Librarian

name: Ms. Librarian
